Technical glossary 10 terms

AI agent

AI that works toward a goal through steps

It changes AI from answering to acting.

Workflow

A connected series of tasks

It helps us judge whether AI is solving a real process, not only producing text.

Tool calling

A model using an external tool or function

It lets AI search, calculate, edit, retrieve, or act beyond chat.

Sandbox

A controlled environment for running actions

It reduces damage if an agent makes a mistake.

Multimodality

Working with text, images, audio, video, screens, or documents

It lets AI understand real learning and work materials.

Confidence score

A signal about how certain extraction or recognition is

It helps humans review document and OCR results.

Latency

Delay before a response arrives

It matters for voice tutors because conversation must feel natural.

Spend control

A rule that limits or tracks cost

It prevents agentic and reasoning-heavy usage from becoming too expensive.

Provider failover

Switching to another provider when one is unavailable

It protects a product from model outages, policy changes, or regional limits.

Human-in-the-loop

Human review inside the workflow

It keeps responsibility clear for important decisions.

Step

What Happens

Risk Or Limit

User gives a goal

The person describes the task or learning need.

A vague goal can produce vague work.

Agent plans

The system breaks the goal into smaller steps.

The plan may miss hidden constraints.

Tools and data are used

The system searches, reads documents, calls APIs, or runs code.

Tools widen the security and privacy surface.

Output is drafted

The system creates a report, lesson, answer, design, or action plan.

A polished output can hide weak evidence.

Verification happens

Humans, tests, or another model check the result.

Verification can be skipped if teams chase speed.

Deployment or feedback

The result reaches users or informs the next step.

Real users need safety, clarity, and a way to correct mistakes.

Key Concepts

AI agent

AI that works toward a goal through steps

It changes AI from answering to acting.

Workflow

A connected series of tasks

It helps us judge whether AI is solving a real process, not only producing text.

Tool calling

A model using an external tool or function

It lets AI search, calculate, edit, retrieve, or act beyond chat.

Sandbox

A controlled environment for running actions

It reduces damage if an agent makes a mistake.

Multimodality

Working with text, images, audio, video, screens, or documents

It lets AI understand real learning and work materials.

Confidence score

A signal about how certain extraction or recognition is

It helps humans review document and OCR results.

Latency

Delay before a response arrives

It matters for voice tutors because conversation must feel natural.

Spend control

A rule that limits or tracks cost

It prevents agentic and reasoning-heavy usage from becoming too expensive.

Provider failover

Switching to another provider when one is unavailable

It protects a product from model outages, policy changes, or regional limits.

Human-in-the-loop

Human review inside the workflow

It keeps responsibility clear for important decisions.
